mapper.sql: s.id, s.exam_id, s.user_id, s.sheet_type, s.status, s.start_time, s.submit_time, s.submit_type, s.subject_answer, s.question_count, s.ai_score, s.manual_score, s.manual_comment, s.final_score, s.pass_flag, s.retake_seq, s.version, s.create_time, s.update_time, e.exam_name, u.user_name, u.user_name AS login_name, d.dept_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM answer_sheet s LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE s.exam_id = #{examId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM answer_sheet s LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE s.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM answer_sheet s LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE s.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY s.id ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, s.id AS sheetId, s.status AS sheetStatus, s.ai_score AS aiScore, s.manual_score AS manualScore, s.manual_comment AS manualComment, s.final_score AS finalScore, s.pass_flag AS passFlag, s.subject_answer AS subjectAnswer, s.submit_time AS submitTime, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM answer_sheet_item ai WHERE ai.answer_sheet_id = s.id) AS itemCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM answer_sheet_item ai WHERE ai.answer_sheet_id = s.id AND ai.user_answer IS NOT NULL AND ai.user_answer != '') AS answeredFiles,
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ai.full_score), 0) FROM answer_sheet_item ai WHERE ai.answer_sheet_id = s.id) AS totalFullScore,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM answer_sheet_item ai WHERE ai.answer_sheet_id = s.id AND ai.manual_score IS NOT NULL) AS gradedCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN answer_sheet s ON s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.exam_id = #{examId} WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.user_id IN ( SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE') ) ORDER BY (s.id IS NULL) ASC, s.submit_time ASC, u.user_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_sheet (exam_id, user_id, sheet_type, status, start_time, submit_time, submit_type, subject_answer, question_count, ai_score, manual_score, final_score, pass_flag, retake_seq, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{examId}, #{userId}, #{sheetType}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{submitTime}, #{submitType}, #{subjectAnswer}, #{questionCount}, #{aiScore}, #{manualScore}, #{finalScore}, #{passFlag}, #{retakeSeq}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_sheet SET status = 'SCORING', final_score = NULL, pass_flag = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.answer_sheet_id, i.question_id, i.subject_item_id, i.seq, i.qtype, i.is_subjective, i.user_answer, i.is_correct, i.ai_score, i.manual_score, i.manual_comment, i.manual_user_id, i.manual_time, i.stem_snapshot, i.full_score, COALESCE(i.stem_snapshot, q.stem, si.title) AS stem, q.answer, q.options_json, q.attachment_url, COALESCE(i.full_score, q.score, si.score) AS score, si.description AS subject_description, si.reference_images AS subject_images, si.attachments_json AS subject_attachments FROM answer_sheet_item i LEFT JOIN question q ON q.id = i.question_id LEFT JOIN exam_subject_item si ON si.id = i.subject_item_id WHERE i.answer_sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY i.seq ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_sheet_item (answer_sheet_id, question_id, subject_item_id, stem_snapshot, full_score, seq, qtype, is_subjective, user_answer, is_correct, ai_score, manual_score, manual_comment, manual_user_id, manual_time, create_time) VALUES (#{answerSheetId}, #{questionId}, #{subjectItemId}, #{stemSnapshot}, #{fullScore}, #{seq}, #{qtype}, #{isSubjective}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{aiScore}, #{manualScore}, #{manualComment}, #{manualUserId}, #{manualTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
